messages:
monica: Quick sync: we need final owner assignments for v1->v2 deprecation work. core deliverables: migration guide, SDK snippet rename (client.call -> client.invoke), embedding model swap + short fallback policy, redirects + banner. timeline: banner on 2026-04-07, docs live 2026-04-06. who owns what?
jared: I can do the JS/TS snippet updates and SDK changelog entries. planning to open PRs per package.
priya: I'll finish the migration guide draft and fold in a rollback FAQ and deployment checklist (canary flow + KV cache warmers). PR soon.
emily: I'll handle redirects and the deprecation banner. Need the list of old doc paths and the embed alias wording for support.
sean: heads-up: streaming framing changed, so chat streaming examples must be updated. I have a small example to paste into the guide.
docs-bot: CI started for branch docs/migration-v1v2. status: in_progress.
monica: action items (short):
 - jared: update snippets across quickstarts + examples (client.call -> client.invoke) and add note in CHANGELOG
 - priya: land migration guide PR and add "Before"/"After" snippet blocks
 - emily: create 301 redirects and schedule banner for 2026-04-06 09:00 PT
 - sean: paste streaming example + run snippet tests against staging
Also need a one-line support blurb for the embed alias fallback (how long we'll map embed-1 -> embed-lite-v2).
jared: do we show both old and new in examples or only new? showing both helps devs but bloats pages.
priya: show both with clear labels. add a short note that the shim will forward v1 calls for 30 days after banner, but it's temporary.
emily: draft support blurb candidate: "Requests using model 'embed-1' will be routed to 'embed-lite-v2' for 30 days after deprecation banner; please migrate to 'embed-lite-v2' for parity and improved latency." ok?
sean: yes. I'll also add a python embedding example. snippet: 
````
# BEFORE
emb = client.embed(model="embed-1", input="text")
# AFTER
emb = client.embed(model="embed-lite-v2", input="text")
````
monica: include both JS and Python. jared, here's a js patch you can apply in quickstarts:
````
// BEFORE
const res = await client.call({ model: "redwood/v1-chat", input: "Hello" });
// AFTER
const res = await client.invoke({ model: "redwood/v2-chat", prompt: "Hello" });
````
jared: will open PRs: docs/pull/3881-js-snippets, docs/pull/3882-ts-quickstarts, docs/pull/3883-npm-examples and link them in the migration guide checklist.
priya: migration guide checklist items: update code samples, redirects, banner copy, support blurb, SDK CHANGES, run snippet smoke tests, add rollout recommendation (24h canary).
emily: I'll need the full list of old paths to map. priya, drop them in the PR description or post here. Also adding docs-deprecation tag for search.
sean: streaming example to include (short):
````
// v1 streaming
for await (const chunk of client.stream("v1-chat", prompt)) {
  // chunk.data
}
// v2 streaming
for await (const event of client.streamEvents({ model: "v2-chat", prompt })) {
  if (event.type === "delta") console.log(event.delta);
}
````
docs-bot: docs build passed for branch docs/migration-v1v2 at 2481241400.
monica: final: once PRs merge, ping #announcements and #support with timeline and support blurb. emily, please schedule the banner for 2026-04-06 and post the support blurb in the internal playbook.
emily: scheduled. I'll merge redirects PR after docs PRs land and will post the announcement.
jared: noted, running snippet updates now. i'll tag emily and priya in PRs.
priya: landing checklist updated on PR 3910. added FAQ about embed regression concerns and guidance for similarity thresholds.
monica: great work, thank you all. I'll circulate an exec one-pager after lunch. :thumbsup:
